# .github/AGENTS.md → pointer to root AGENTS.md

> The source-of-truth AGENTS.md lives at the **repository root**: `/AGENTS.md`
> This file is a runtime copy managed by the root-to-.github sync script.
> **Do not edit this file directly.** Edit `/AGENTS.md` instead.

---

See `/AGENTS.md` for:
- AI tool discovery map (Claude, Copilot, Codex, Trae)
- Full repository directory tree with file descriptions
- Agent roster and team structure
- Agent workflow, hierarchy, and feedback loops
- Quality gate checklist (7 gates)
- Technology stack and CI commands
- Hard boundaries / NEVER rules
- PR & commit conventions
- Filename and formatting conventions

Cascading overrides: a subdirectory `AGENTS.override.md` takes precedence over `/AGENTS.md` for that subdirectory.
